keyframes.prompt: Vertical 2:3 cinematic photorealistic photo: terraced green rice fields on mountain slopes in northern Vietnam at sunrise, thin morning mist in the valleys, dew on the rice leaves, warm golden sunlight from the left, soft haze. Peaceful, epic, National Geographic style. No people. No text, no watermark.

Create a new image in the same cinematic warm golden style: vertical 2:3 close-up of the weathered hands of an old Vietnamese farmer gently holding a handful of golden rice grains, standing in a rice field, warm sunrise light glowing through the fingers, shallow depth of field, green rice behind. Only hands visible. No text, no watermark.

Create a new image in the same cinematic warm style: vertical 2:3 photo of a Mekong Delta floating market in Vietnam in early morning, wooden boats full of fruits and vegetables on a calm brown river, coconut palms on the bank, soft golden light, light mist.
